name: Execution {OS}
tagline: Time-bound personal commitments and proof of output.

commands.name: /boot
commands.summary: Open the day: capacity, usable minutes, one must-win, the day's commitments.

commands.name: /capture
commands.summary: Record an incoming item without judging it.

commands.name: /clarify
commands.summary: Empty the inbox by classifying every entry.

commands.name: /commit
commands.summary: Turn an intention into a commitment with an acceptance test and one physical next action.

commands.name: /focus
commands.summary: Protect a block of 25, 50 or 90 minutes on exactly one commitment.

commands.name: /prove
commands.summary: Close a commitment on evidence plus the acceptance test it satisfies.

commands.name: /recover
commands.summary: Classify a failed commitment as blocked, deferred, cancelled or delegated, with a next action.

commands.name: /promise
commands.summary: Record a promise to another person, with a notice-by date and a consequence.

commands.name: /capacity
commands.summary: Show or set the capacity budget, and name the overflow.

commands.name: /halt
commands.summary: Close the day with a classification, a proof and tomorrow's first physical action.

commands.name: /reset
commands.summary: The weekly reset: the honest truth, next week's single win, one system experiment.

commands.name: /audit
commands.summary: The monthly system audit: one change to the system, with its test.

requires_human_approval_for: cancelling a commitment that carries a promise to another person
sending or drafting a late-promise notice to a stakeholder
changing an agreed deadline held by a client or a teammate
deleting or rewriting historical ledger entries, including proofs
handing a commitment to Team & Delegation {OS}
